genome: Every ingroup genome with a retrievable assembly is listed: 260 cultured RGM and SGM isolates, 320 uncultured reference genomes and 243 SPIRE MAGs, 823 rows in all. The one ingroup genome absent here, GCA_025965895.1, could not be retrieved and carries no Bakta annotation. All 823 runs used Bakta v1.11.4 with database v6.0 (full) and the same flag set (--db, --output, --prefix, --threads, --skip-plot, --force); they differ only in thread count (3, 4, 8 or 12) and in whether --skip-plot precedes --force, neither of which affects the annotation. In 321 rows, the 320 reference genomes and one MAG re-run with them, <out> and <fna> stand for the output and input directories of that batch, which ran in a working directory that was not retained; every other token in those commands is verbatim. The isolate and MAG rows carry their literal paths, and their per-run logs are in bakta_isolates/ and bakta_out/.
